title: Independently reconstruct PR4441 helper tariffs and complete p17 invoice
body:
PR #4441's helper retiming changes the recursive rank distribution. This package independently reconstructs the link from its literal frame contacts to its complete complex invoice, without importing the predecessor's synthesizer or verifiers. No accounting discrepancy was found in the checked scope.

Each full native invocation removes **191 paid calls** while increasing both productive and paid rank mass by **133**. Across all 19 invocations, the complete controller has **69,273 paid calls** (3,629 fewer), **11,560 productive fields**, and rank masses **260,798 / 259,998**, preserving surplus **800**.

Start with [the audit README](https://github.com/mihir-s-05/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6d535abed7b60d4a99dc54903011a72ec367e901/research/fresh-helper-invoice-audit/README.md), [independent implementation](https://github.com/mihir-s-05/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6d535abed7b60d4a99dc54903011a72ec367e901/research/fresh-helper-invoice-audit/audit.py), and [derived receipt](https://github.com/mihir-s-05/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6d535abed7b60d4a99dc54903011a72ec367e901/research/fresh-helper-invoice-audit/RESULT.json).

### Checked scope

- Binary Gaussian elimination validates frame bases and nested paths for all 632 persistent roles in both orientations. All 117 entrance, 42 exit and 395 scalar-frame patches are bound to their original contacts.
- A separate exact Laurent replay executes both scalar boundaries and all 164 controller events, derives the main diagonal, and retains every full call, query shear and whole idle charge.
- An empty-patch positive control reconstructs the original invoice. Per-role dimension telescoping independently explains the conserved surplus.
- Thirteen rejection controls cover dropped queries/idles, wrong signs and coefficients, infeasible frames, omitted patches, false productive credit and altered source bytes.

This is a **finite accounting audit**, not independent acceptance of the proposed kappa or full theorem. Native arbitrary-column action, Clifford phases, owned-query/center erasure, physical routing, tails, compiler, BIT, precision, stock and outer admission remain outside this check. No selected record or predecessor file changes.

### Sources and overlap

Started from canonical main `2a13eb1827784206202db90e5dc8327cf8a250db`, priority revision 7. Audited #4441 head `5f9d871c6bd1b9e34db5a7ea5ef08a908e94db39`. Two native inputs are pinned on main; five exact PR snapshots are retained with source paths, Git blobs, SHA256s and credit. Replay requires no unmerged Git objects or network access.

The closing live snapshot covered 302 open PRs and 3,294 Discussion records. Sparse local and closed-PR-body coverage remains incomplete. Concurrent #4446 at `7d05d73f96c27a9d360011e04af69b23fa903757` certifies the same profile and reruns #4441's native code. This contribution adds a separate per-role contact-path reconstruction and conservation check; it claims no competing construction or endpoint. Canonical coordination: [Discussion #4443](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4443).

### Validation

CPython 3.12.0, Windows 11 x64:

```sh
python -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/fresh-helper-invoice-audit --check-only
python -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/fresh-helper-invoice-audit
python -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/fresh-helper-invoice-audit
```

Metadata/pins, normal and optimized registered replays, all 13 controls, committed-byte checks and `git diff --check` passed. A 15-file export passed integrity checks and both direct modes in a fresh Git-free directory. Scientific code/input commit: `6ffff4e474b97e9fcc1e13164676e372a9d3af80`; final documentation/metadata head: `6d535abed7b60d4a99dc54903011a72ec367e901`. The full-history ancestry preflight was not run in this shallow checkout. Selected-source baseline orientation was attempted but cannot complete in the sparse checkout; the unrelated selected cold replay was not run. Hosted CI is pending.

Construction credit stays with @1337isnot1337, Cinna Davis, zxv, Jacob Alan Sussman and the retained native/Clifford/BIT/outer contributors. This audit was prepared for Mihir Srivastava (@mihir-s-05) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. Apache-2.0.
